newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares fall in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares fall in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares fell on Wednesday on the privately-operated Beirut Secondary Market (BSM).
A shares -- distributed to former holders of property rights in the Beirut central district SOLIDERE is rebuilding -- fell to $103.125 from $105.0 on Tuesday.
B shares -- issued in a $650-million subscription in January 1994 -- fell to $106 from $106.25.
Turnover on BSM, which trades only SOLIDERE shares, fell to 9,740 shares from Tuesday's 12,852 and value was $1,018,143 from $1,345,172.
SOLIDERE, Lebanon's biggest company, will move its shares to the official Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE) on September 30, market sources said.
There was no trade on the BSE on Wednesday in any of the listed companies: Ciments Libanais Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
On Tuesday, 10,000 Ciments Libanais shares were traded at $1.1875.
The BLOM Stock Index which covers both markets fell 1.04 percent to 894.76 and the LISPI index fell 0.29 percent to 81.35.
